snippet.title: A Dark Cave  Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You wake up in a dark cave with no memory. Survive. Gather. Craft. Build. Fight. Dig deeper.

This is a short look at A Dark Cave: a minimalist, atmospheric incremental game about surviving the dark, raising a settlement, and uncovering what’s waiting below. Inspired by the classics, with its own dark twist.

I’m Julian, the solo developer. The Steam version is playable for free right now.

Free Demo / Wishlist / Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4882240/A_Dark_Cave/

Play free in browser:
https://a-dark-cave.com/

Community:
https://www.reddit.com/r/aDarkCave/

If you like dark incremental, idle, survival, or settlement games, a wishlist helps a lot. Feedback is always welcome. Thank you!
